Do you want to see a Super New Girl, Part 3?
What is your favorite power so far?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So... How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: You seem to know the material.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I'm glad to see that receiving detention did not throw you off your game.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Now who would like to follow up $SUPERZOE's stellar performance?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So... How'd I do?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I had hoped that you would do better.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: As tempting as it is to talk about personal issues at school...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Personal troubles are no excuse to shirk off your assignments.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I want a one-page summary from you about the content of the chapter we just read.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh... Detention `and` a paper?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Now, who is next?
At lunch...
Sam joins $SUPERZOE at the popular table.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, I heard you got detention. Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm not `thrilled` about it, but I'll be fine...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]thrilled[/i][/color] about it, but I'll be fine...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great. I wanted to ask you a favor.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What kind of favor?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I need you to talk to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh. Didn't you talk to him?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I couldn't. They put him in one of the special holding cells for the really bad students.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd have to be let into the detention room in order to do that!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Maybe you should try getting detention...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I did.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sam, you didn't! Aunt Cathy's been hounding you about getting in trouble in school after you blew up the classroom in Dangerous Chemicals and Noxious Fumes...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: ...Which I still can't believe I'm taking!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'll be glad to know getting detention didn't work at all!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I tried to set something on fire in algebra, but the sprinklers just went off instead.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That explains the puddles on the floor...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Instead of putting me in detention, I have to stay and clean the mess in the algebra room.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So you want me to talk to Colt?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're the only chance I have.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I heard rumors that Colt's going to be transported to `Super Boot Camp.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I heard rumors that Colt's going to be transported to [color=#3b78e2][i]Super Boot Camp.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Boot Camp is punishment. They make you really work there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You have to run with bears, swim with the salmon, and...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hear they make you roll a boulder up a mountain for ages!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That sounds... Awful.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And worse, they don't let you use cell phones or email or even mental telepathy there...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When they send him to Boot Camp, he'll be gone for good. I'll never get to ask him why he did what he did.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'll talk to him for you. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: That is wrong.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: There are 4 floating islands, one for each of the four schools in this area.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: There's one for every school...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: There are 4 floating islands, one for each of the four schools in this area.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: That is wrong.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: There are 4 floating islands, one for each of the four schools in this area.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Clearly.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: There are 4 floating islands, one for each of the four schools in this area.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I have one final question for you...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: How many floating islands are there?

nodes.prompt: How many floating islands are there?

menu.text: How many floating islands are there?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: That's preposterous.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The islands are held up by mysterious and complicated machinery.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: That's preposterous.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The islands are held up by mysterious and complicated machinery.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: That is correct. There is a mechanism located on each island.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: The book says the mechanism that helps the islands float was created long ago, but we don't even remember it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If only our ancestors took as great notes as you...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The islands are held up by mysterious and complicated machinery.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: The islands are held up by mysterious and complicated machinery.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: But $SUPERZOE, we are not done yet. Your next question...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: What holds the floating islands up?

nodes.prompt: How do the floating islands stay up?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: How do the floating islands stay up?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Correct. Super-powered teens' lack of experience and control forced the town to put them in these floating institutions.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He makes it sound like we're in jail...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: It is because super powered teens were such disasters. They threatened to destroy the town.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Most certainly not...

nodes.text: It is because super powered teens were such disasters. They threatened to destroy the town.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: It is because super powered teens were such disasters. They threatened to destroy the town.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hopefully, he'll be in one of the detention cells.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good night, $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Good night, Sam.
The next morning...
$SUPERZOE dashes through the school halls!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I overslept! I'm going to be late!
$SUPERZOE turns a corner and enters the classroom.
Though no one is talking, $SUPERZOE doesn't see anyone at the front of the room. She sighs with relief.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Oh good! Professor Doom's not here yet!
$SUPERZOE slips into a seat next to Howard. She leans over and whispers to him.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Whew! I didn't think I'd get here before Professor Doom!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ahem, uh, $SUPERZOE...
Howard points frantically towards the ceiling above her.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What are you pointing at?
$SUPERZOE looks up and finds Professor Doom floating above her.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Eek!
He lands, looming over her.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: You are late.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Professor. I... I stayed up late last night. That entire thing with Colt on the football field...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: These things can be very upsetting, but having super powers comes with the price of facing disaster.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: And disaster is no excuse for tardiness.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: That will be fifteen minutes of detention. Please stop by the detention room after school.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yes, Professor.
Professor Doom glides to the front of the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Now that all students are here, we shall begin the lesson.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: It occurs to us faculty that many of you students do not know about the history of Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's there to know? We're on a gigantic island made of candy, held in place with floating marshmallows!

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I cannot think of anything more wrong than what you've just said.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Do you know why this island floats? Or even why it was created?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well, no...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Then for the next thirty minutes, we'll take some time to review the text.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Please partner with the person next to you and read through the chapter. Then we shall review.
Howard and $SUPERZOE scoot their desks together and open their books. $SUPERZOE reads...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: 'In the early years of Super Age, super powered teenagers had little control over their powers and accidentally caused severe and heavy damages to the city.'

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: 'As a result, Centerscore founders built floating islands. These islands served as safe havens where those with powers could learn to control their skills...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'There are four islands in all: Centerscore High, Wilson High, Monarch Prep, and Spartan Academy.'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'It is unknown what machinery holds the islands up as that technology has been lost to time...'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Blah blah blah. Come on, everyone knows this stuff already.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: That doesn't mean we should slack off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It means we can for a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry you got detention.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No, it's my fault... I shouldn't have overslept.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Didn't Sam wake you up?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: She came early to find Colt and talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She wants to talk to him? After what he did to her?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I know... I...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And, uh, that is how Spartan, Monarch, Wilson, and Centerscore all came to be floating islands.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Very nice, Howard and $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Since you appear to be done, maybe one of you would like to answer the first handful of questions on our super `pop quiz.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Since you appear to be done, maybe one of you would like to answer the first handful of questions on our super [color=#e23b3b][i]pop quiz.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: I know you're familiar with our history. $SUPERZOE, why don't you start us off?

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Why were the floating islands created?

nodes.prompt: Why were the floating islands created?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Why were the floating islands created?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Honestly, Sam, I think it'd be good for you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You said yourself... This isn't like him. Maybe something's up, and you can get through to him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...For a second, I thought you were going to go all 'goody-space-shoes' on me. My mom `hates` Colt. She's always going off about him.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...For a second, I thought you were going to go all 'goody-space-shoes' on me. My mom [color=#3b78e2][i]hates[/i][/color] Colt. She's always going off about him.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Glad I could empathize.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really think it's a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, no. But it's important that you figure it out for yourself.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Don't forget that you can walk away any time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know... But I'm still going to school early to find him.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sounds like you were lucky to escape from him the first time.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Something bad could have happened to you. You should definitely leave him alone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You `would` say that.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's like talking to my mother.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She never did like Colt. She thought he was trouble.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But he `is` trouble.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt's nice deep down.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You sound like you're making excuses for him. If he's a bad guy...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's `not` bad. I told you, I've never seen him act like this.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] bad. I told you, I've never seen him act like this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's tough, but he's not `evil!`

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to talk to him tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What are you going to say?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know... But I'm going to school early to find him.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So what exactly happened between the two of you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We dated for awhile back when I was at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And things were going really well until this party...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt's a little proud, and he got into a fight with this rich guy named Tom Prince.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I managed to pull him away, but at some point in the middle of the party, he totally `ditched me` and `stole Tom's limo.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I managed to pull him away, but at some point in the middle of the party, he totally [color=#3b78e2][i]ditched me[/i][/color] and [color=#3b78e2][i]stole Tom's limo.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. He took Tom Prince's space limo and almost crashed it into the sun.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought I knew him...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it turns out I know nothing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just wish I understood what really happened tonight.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: You should...

nodes.prompt: You should...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Like you both have very strong personalities.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: People with strong personalities tend to attract each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I suppose that is true.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I hope I didn't offend you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not at all. We are both really strong-willed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was part of the problem with our relationship...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, I'm `troubled` now, am I?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: No, I didn't mean it like that... It's just... Well, you know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I don't. Why don't you tell me?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: It's just... Sometimes you do things that are a little alienating...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like what?
$SUPERZOE can smell the plastic of Sam's toothbrush as it melts in her fiery hands.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Like that! Your toothbrush is melting like a popsicle!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine, I guess we might both have bad tempers.
At midfield, Colt stands up and runs forward to continue his assault when he's stopped by an arc of flames!
Sam steps onto the field.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Get out of my way.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what if I don't?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll make you move.
Before Sam can do anything, he shoves her roughly to the side and dashes forward.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, that's it!
Sam streaks forward after him, trails of fire blazing behind her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm taking you down!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not doing this to me after what happened last time!
Sam peppers Colt with fireballs!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's it!
Colt snarls and bares his claws. He about-faces and flies straight at Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eat this!
Sam throws fireball after fireball, but he dodges them one after another...
Until he's almost on her...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sam, watch out!
$SUPERZOE starts to thrust her shield out when there is a loud crack in the middle of the field.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: `STOP.`

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: `That is enough.`
The creepy voice booms across the football stadium, and Sam and Colt fall where they were fighting.
Professor Doom strides forward and plucks Colt from the floor.
Colt snarls weakly, but before Colt can act, Professor Doom fixes him in an intense gaze, his eyes glowing red and menacing.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: `You are not going to give me any trouble.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You are not going to give me any trouble.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... No, I won't give you any trouble...

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: Good.
Professor Doom glares at everyone in the stands.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: `Move along... There is nothing to see here...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Move along... There is nothing to see here...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: He takes Colt by the arm and stops in front of $SUPERZOE.

nodes.speaker: Professor Doom
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, make sure your cousin Sam gets home safely.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Of course, sir.
Professor Doom leaves, dragging a suspiciously obedient Colt along with him.
$SUPERZOE goes to Sam and helps her to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Sam, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unngh... My head hurts...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But other than that... What happened?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I have `no` idea...
That night, $SUPERZOE and Sam get ready for bed.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So Colt was your ex-boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm kind of sorry to say that he was.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Was he always this crazy?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! He wasn't! I don't know why he attacked. He's never even met Howard, so there's no reason to go after him. Or you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Geez, this whole thing is a mess...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have no idea what I saw in Colt after the way he acted tonight.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Actually, I can kind of see you two together...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And just what is `that` supposed to mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: And just what is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Well, you two both seem...

nodes.prompt: You two both seem...

nodes.text: $SUPERZOE freezes, unable to move as Colt barrels straight into her!
Just as Colt is about to strike, Howard blindsides him, sending him reeling!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $SUPERZOE, you okay?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah, I just...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry. That's twice now you've saved my life.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. Here, let me get you off the field.
Before Howard can move, they hear a loud rumbling noise!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry you had to save me...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Did we get him?
$SUPERZOE turns herself and everything around her invisible!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What...?
This confuses Colt enough for Howard to blindside him!
The force sends Colt flying backwards into the forest at the edge of the football field!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good work, $SUPERZOE!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
$SUPERZOE winks back into sight.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Did we get him?
But before Colt can reach Howard, the other cheerleaders step up!
Keith makes a fist and jabs it straight at Colt, his arm extending out like a stretching rubber band!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pft. Lame. Is that all you got?
Colt blocks one arm, but Keith's other arm snakes around and clocks him!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, not lame.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Annoying.`
Colt snags Keith's arms and ties them in a knot!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Owwwwww!`

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not so fast...
Hector transforms into an octopus, his sticky arms reaching out in an attempt to trip Colt...
Instead, Colt streaks past Hector, knocking him to the side! Hector gets tangled up in the lower level of the bleachers.
Then Colt turns back and rushes at Howard and $SUPERZOE!
Howard leaps into the air and flies down towards Colt like a missile! He hits the ground, nearly knocking everyone to their knees with his impact.
Colt jumps over the expanding mushroom cloud and runs straight towards the end zone...
And right at $SUPERZOE!
He angles his metal claws at $SUPERZOE's head!

nodes.prompt: React!

nodes.text: A force shield springs up between her and Colt right before he closes those last few yards...
Colt hits the shield with such force that it bounces him back to midfield!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good work, $SUPERZOE!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Thanks, but...
She points in the direction Colt bounced off to.
Colt shakes off the rebuff and starts running at them again...
$SUPERZOE backs up and braces herself against the goal post for support.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This time, I'm ready...
Howard turns and glares at Colt.
$SUPERZOE's shield fails her!
Metal claws outstretched, Colt leaps into the air, his eyes on $SUPERZOE!
$SUPERZOE can't tear her eyes away... For a moment, it looks like she will become one of Colt's victims...
When Howard swoops in and pushes her out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Ohhh!
$SUPERZOE lands and rolls, coming to rest at the base of the goal post. Orienting herself, she looks up in time to see Howard punch Colt, sending him back to midfield!
Howard runs up to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry about that. You okay?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Yeah... Sorry I couldn't put up a shield in time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay. Just try to stay back.
Howard turns and glares at Colt, who has started a second pass.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: He's... He's been brainwashed. Pretty thoroughly by the feel of it.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Brainwashed to do what?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know... He only has one goal, it seems.

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Who would brainwash him?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't say...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Is there any way to snap him out of it?

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: Because once he gets through that door, I think we're in trouble...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can't do anything with my powers. Not on a brainwashing that powerful...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I suppose if there were some way we could flood his mind with memories stronger than the message that's looping inside his head...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: We could get him to remember his last fight with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes! Something that stirs up a lot of emotion...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: But what was it that he and Sam fought about?
$SUPERZOE searches her memory...
Last night...

nodes.speaker: Superzoe
nodes.text: So what exactly happened between the you and Colt?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We dated for awhile back when I was at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And things were going really well until this party...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt's a little proud, and he got into a fight with this rich guy named Tom Prince.
